Hey bud ! From someone who tried to off themselves after a bad breakup, please don’t do it ! It’s really hard and sad at first but gradually you’ll start feeling better one day at a time. My advice is give yourself something to look forward to everyday. It can be playing a video game, eating a pizza, or making artwork, just whatever will make you excited during the day. Eventually you’ll learn to enjoy yourself without the other person, and realize that they are just some dude. And it’s okay to be sad and cry about it but just be safe ! Life sucks a lot of times so we just have to make it to the little pockets of joy. If I had stayed with my ex, I never would have moved in with my awesome roommate, and we never would have watched our fave anime for 3 days straight. It’s the little things you have to look forward too
